item.title: Notes on starting to use Django
item.description:
📝 I assume that I could edit those scripts if I wanted, but so far I’ve just been running the generated scripts with no change and it’s been going great. It really feels like magic. I’ve been following these instructions for using SQLite with Django in production.
🔗 Read more: https://jvns.ca/blog/2026/01/27/some-notes-on-starting-to-use-django/
